summary: Rezones 3.9 acres at Cane Ridge Road (unnumbered), about 776 feet southeast of Preston Road, from AR2a to RM20 RM9-NS.

judge.problem: The summary gives the new zoning as 'RM20 RM9-NS', copying a garbled phrase from the body text. The title says the change is from AR2a to RM20, and the body shows both RM20 and RM9-NS, so the summary presents an inconsistent designation as if it were a single district and does not match the title's RM20.
